name: query_service_logs
description: Query background service logs (follow-up daemon, self-healing daemon, reminder scheduler). Use this to check what the services are doing, find errors, or get statistics. Examples: 'Show me service errors', 'What has the self-healing daemon done?', 'Are the services running okay?'

service.description: Which service to query: 'follow_up' (re-alert daemon), 'self_healing' (auto-resolve daemon), 'reminder' (reminder scheduler), or 'all' (all services)

event_type.description: Filter by event type: 'action' (service actions), 'error' (errors only), 'check' (periodic checks), 'startup', 'shutdown'. Omit for all events.

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (default: 20)

show_stats.description: If true, show statistics instead of detailed logs (default: false)
